name: Tax Rate Gap
description: Gap between the US federal statutory tax rate (21%) and the effective tax rate (income tax expense / pretax income); a larger gap means paying further below statutory, a proxy for reduced contribution to public finances.

name: Revenue Volatility
description: Coefficient of variation of year-over-year revenue growth over the trailing 5 fiscal years; higher volatility means a less predictable economic contribution to workers, suppliers and tax receipts.

name: Employment Growth
description: 3-year CAGR of employee headcount, as a proxy for the company's contribution to job creation.
source: SEC 10-K Human Capital disclosures (self-extracted, no longer depends on universe/financials.csv)

name: Federal contract revenue concentration
description: Direct federal procurement contract obligations as a share of revenue - higher means more of the company's revenue depends on one customer, the US federal budget, so it is more exposed to appropriations or policy shifts. Does not capture subcontractor exposure.
source: SEC XBRL quarterly revenue + USASpending.gov federal contract obligations
